void.string: <GuidelineTitle> Inhaler Technique Review for Adults With Asthma
<CommitteeExpertise> two nurses, one pharmacist and one physician
<InclusionCriterion> adults aged 18 years or older with a diagnosis of asthma who use an inhaler
<ExclusionCriterion> people who use a nebuliser only
<Recommendation> A nurse or pharmacist should watch the patient use their inhaler at every asthma review.
<Directive> watch the patient use their inhaler at every asthma review
<Recommendation> If the patient makes an error in technique, the clinician should demonstrate the correct technique and ask the patient to repeat it.
<DecisionVariable> the patient makes an error in technique
<Action> demonstrate the correct technique and ask the patient to repeat it
<Logic> If the patient makes an error in technique is [true] Then demonstrate the correct technique and ask the patient to repeat it
<Recommendation> If the patient cannot use a pressurised metered-dose inhaler correctly after teaching, the clinician should offer a spacer.
<DecisionVariable> the patient cannot use a pressurised metered-dose inhaler correctly after teaching
<TermMeaning> A holding chamber attached to a metered-dose inhaler.
<TermMeaning> A planned visit to assess control, treatment and technique.
